title: Selling Plans — Refunded Share Bands for Refund Credits
content:
How much of a variable final value fee a **Selling Plans** refund credit returns is banded by how much of the order the seller refunded. The refunds are the seller-funded refund debits for the order on the seller's Northloop Payments ledger, added together; the proportional share is that total divided by the order's fee basis, never above one.

**Rule.** For the variable fee credit, the refunded share is counted as one when the refunds reach at least the whole-order refund share of the fee basis, as half of the proportional share when they are no more than the small-refund share of the fee basis, and as the proportional share between the two.

## Bands

| Seller-funded refunds for the order, as a share of its fee basis | Refunded share used |
|---|---|
| 90% or more (the whole-order refund share) | One |
| More than 25% but below 90% | The proportional share |
| 25% or less (the small-refund share) | Half of the proportional share (a factor of 0.5) |

## Both sides of each band (hypothetical order, fee basis USD 400.00)

| Refunds for the order | Proportional share | Refunded share used |
|---|---|---|
| USD 360.00 | 0.9 | One |
| USD 356.00 | 0.89 | 0.89 |
| USD 104.00 | 0.26 | 0.26 |
| USD 100.00 | 0.25 | Half of 0.25, which is 0.125 |
